title: Jake Barber's orbs phasing into mountains over the range

tellings.quote: Didn't Jake Barber talk about some of the like light orbs or weird non really physically identifiable craft he'd see over the range would like almost phase into mountains

plain: An online UFO researcher who goes by UAPGerb, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, recalls that a man named Jake Barber, who says he worked with unidentified craft, talked about glowing orbs of light and strange, hard-to-pin-down craft he would see over a test range in California. According to that recollection, they would almost pass into the mountains, as if solid rock were no barrier, which would mean they behave unlike any known object.
